content.short: Rejuve.AI is a longevity app where users share health data, track metrics, and earn RJV token rewards.
content.description: Rejuve.AI is a longevity-focused Web3 app that lets users track health metrics, contribute data, and earn RJV token rewards. The Longevity App is designed to help people monitor habits and health signals while giving them more control over the value of their data. RJV tokens can connect users with discounts, services, and ecosystem benefits around supplements, medical tests, travel, and longevity therapies. The project links personal wellness with decentralized data ownership and health research.
